name: tutor-matcher
description: Matchmaking platform connecting tutors and students by subject, schedule, and price.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix apps/backend install && npm --prefix apps/frontend install
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run setup:env && npm --prefix apps/backend run db:migrate:dev && npm --prefix apps/backend run gen-mock-data
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,green "npm --prefix apps/backend run dev" "npm --prefix apps/frontend run dev"
scripts.up: npm run db:up && pm2 start ecosystem.config.js && pm2 list && node scripts/print-dev-urls.mjs
